==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Lexia:''' Oh, dearest Elisha... what shall our next ballet be?
:{{DIcon}} Who are you talking to?
:'''Lexia:''' Ah, {{Rover}}, is that you? I was just asking Elisha what our next performance should be...
:'''Lexia:''' See, each island nation has its own preferences, you know.
:'''Lexia:''' Take [[Septimont]], for example. They favor plays like "The Three Hundred Knights of Capitoline" and "Assassin's Journey"—you know, action-packed, filled with historical sagas and war. That's their thing.
:'''Lexia:''' I like them too, but Elisha doesn't share my enthusiasm.
:'''Lexia:''' She prefers heart-wrenching tragedies like "The Shape of the Ocean" or "The Perished Waterworld." You know, those tear-jerking stories that only the [[Riccioli Islands|Riccioli]] people seem to appreciate...
:'''Lexia:''' But I can't stand that place. And let's be honest, tragedy is not in my wheelhouse. Ugh... it's so frustrating, Elisha, my dear Elisha...
{{Dialogue End}}
